title: LRI error is reported as large
symptom: The reporting layer flags a large LibRI screening error.
evidence_required: current threshold values for that layer

candidate_experiments.action: decrease the threshold family of the reporting layer
candidate_experiments.expected_improvement: tightens screening and reduces the numerical LibRI error
candidate_experiments.guard: change the family coherently and check cost and conditioning

stop_condition: The LRI error is below the reporting threshold or the basis becomes ill-conditioned (go to r9).
